title: Introduction to Tajwiid
modules: Articulation Of The Letters Of The
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to stressed Miim [ ّ ]مand stressed Nuun [ ّ ]نrespectively."
Al-Miimu 'l-Mushaddadah wa'n-Nuunu 'l-Mushaddadah refer to stressed Miim [ ّ ]مand stressed Nuun [ ّ ]نrespectively.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means elongation or lengthening of sounds."
Madd means elongation or lengthening of sounds.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an everyday 'ibaadah expected of Muslims."
Quran recitation is an everyday 'ibaadah expected of Muslims.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is any voweless laam in any verb like . الْھاكمThe two rules applicable to this Laam are Assimilation ('Idghaam) and Manifestation ('Izhaar)."
Verbal Laam is any voweless laam in any verb like . الْھاكمThe two rules applicable to this Laam are Assimilation ('Idghaam) and Manifestation ('Izhaar).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an act of worship ('ibaadah) expected of all Muslims at all times."
The remembrance of Allah is an act of worship ('ibaadah) expected of all Muslims at all times.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a special clacking sound that usually accompanies these letters when they carry Sukuun, either in the middle of a word or become Sukuun by virtue of a stop."
Qalqalah itself is a special clacking sound that usually accompanies these letters when they carry Sukuun, either in the middle of a word or become Sukuun by virtue of a stop.
fib: ______ refers to any voweless Miim in the Quran (that is, any Miim that carries the sign of Sukuun).
Al-Miimu's-Saakinah refers to any voweless Miim in the Quran (that is, any Miim that carries the sign of Sukuun).
______ means a break in sound and breath (At-tanaffus).
Waqf (stop) in Tajwiid terminology means a break in sound and breath (At-tanaffus).
______ is considered the best form of dhikr (Rememberance of Allah).
Recitation of the Quran is considered the best form of dhikr (Rememberance of Allah).
______ is the only Quranic letter that has this attribute.
Raa' is the only Quranic letter that has this attribute.
______ are described based on the three attributes known as the "three term label" in modern linguistics.
Letters are described based on the three attributes known as the "three term label" in modern linguistics.
______ is the pronominal suffix that denotes the third person singular pronoun when used in the accusative or genitive case.
Haa' of pronoun is the pronominal suffix that denotes the third person singular pronoun when used in the accusative or genitive case.
